research_notes: Supplier M labels are diameter labels, not proof of a metric machine thread.
The alternative plastic screw dimensions are research leads, not selected geometry. At 1.4 mm the Japanese brochure lists Type P pitch 0.50 (or 0.61 special), B 0.45 and S 0.30.
